json.title: Mountains Turning Pink
json.logline: A winter family journey to Gangtok culminates in a quiet dawn as snow peaks bloom in warm pink alpenglow.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
a young South Asian woman with dark shoulder-length hair
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Fade in on soft blue twilight over Gangtok valley
Warm amber light blooms on distant hill slopes
Four-on-the-floor kick drum drives shift toward sunrise
Radiant pink alpenglow ignites across the snow-capped Kanchenjunga range
Layered visual fragments of fluttering prayer flags in rosy sunlight
Drums fade, leaving a warm chord over glowing mountain crests
Final piano chord decays as morning light covers the valley

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the cold glass frame
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman leans softly against a misty window pane looking outward.
scenes.setting: A dimly lit Gangtok hotel room overlooking shadowy mountain ridges at dawn.

scenes.camera_note: Horizontal floating drift revealing hill slopes
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman stands on a terraced viewpoint facing quiet mountain peaks.
scenes.setting: A high scenic ridge above Gangtok town shrouded in soft blue twilight.

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up from steaming cup to distant horizon
scenes.action: Steam rises gently from a warm terracotta cup resting on a wooden railing.
scenes.setting: A frosty balcony edge overlooking the vast Himalayan valley.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push-in capturing the sudden light shift
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman turns her head as pink morning light touches her cheek.
scenes.setting: An open wooden viewing deck in the chilly morning air.

scenes.camera_note: Wide majestic pull-out revealing the full mountain range
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman raises her arms toward the glowing pink snowfields.
scenes.setting: A panoramic Himalayan vantage point where huge snow peaks ignite in brilliant pink alpenglow.

scenes.camera_note: Layered drifting motion across dynamic mountain elements
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman watches colorful prayer flags stream in the ridge wind.
scenes.setting: A high mountain pass decorated with vibrant flags illuminated by warm sunlight.

scenes.camera_note: Slow retreat as quietness settles over the scene
scenes.action: The young South Asian woman smiles serenely into the soft morning air.
scenes.setting: A peaceful hilltop terrace overlooking Gangtok bathed in warm golden dawn.
